Subject: POC trial planning - Lakeside Health

Hi Claire / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can land on a clean POC scope: 

Recap / goals:
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference integration for real-time triage workflows in Lakeside’s patient intake app.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Latency: 95th percentile < 180ms for 512-token requests during peak test windows.
  2) Throughput: sustain 100 reqs/min for 15-minute steady-state windows without errors.
  3) Quality: human-review pass rate >= 85% on the 200-sample evaluation set (template attached).
  4) Data controls: logs and KV cache retained in customer VPC during private trial window.

POC / evaluation plan (high level):
- 4-week trial: week 0 kickoff + infra + smoke tests; weeks 1-3 evaluation and tuning; final week wrap + handoff.
- Redwood to provide a preconfigured trial endpoint (dedicated slice) + an evaluation harness (attached).
- Lakeside provides a representative sample dataset + success criteria signoff.

Ownership / RACI (initial draft attached):
- Redwood infra: Aditya Rao (setup, baseline tests, perf tuning)
- Lakeside app integration: Claire / Raj (SDK integration, sample payloads)
- Security & compliance: Lakeside security lead (confirm requirements), Redwood to provide audit logs and config.
- Procurement & contracts: Lakeside procurement (need point of contact) and Redwood legal (Lauren B.).

Attachments: POC_RACI_Lakeside_v1.xlsx (RACI + timeline), POC_Eval_Template_Lakeside_v1.docx (eval checklist).

Next steps / asks:
1) Claire: confirm success criteria above and share the security contact + procurement POC (name and timeline).
2) Raj: share representative payloads and an initial 200-sample eval set by EOD next Tue (6/30).
3) Aditya: will schedule infra kickoff after Claire confirms access method (VPC peering vs secure tunnel).
4) Lauren: I’ve cc’d you for procurement/contract cadence — can you confirm standard SOW timeline?

If everyone is happy with the above, I’ll drop an updated RACI and calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
